o.norm: Request a string in an area of the Basic Multilingual Plane that is largely occupied by private characters

i.norm: The first code point of the Private Use Area in the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP). The range {@code 0xE000}..{@code 0xF8FF} is reserved for private use characters.
The largest code point that still lies within the Basic Multilingual Plane.
Number of code points to generate; large enough to reliably exercise the private-use range.
Request a string from a slice of the Basic Multilingual Plane that is largely occupied by private-use characters. The generator must never emit any of them.
Walk the string code point by code point (a single code point may span two chars) and confirm none of them are private-use characters.
